patents.patent_title: Reinforcement learning agent for robotic manipulation
patents.patent_abstract: A deep reinforcement learning framework training robotic arms to perform dexterous manipulation tasks using proximal policy optimisation.

patents.patent_title: Convolutional neural network for medical image segmentation
patents.patent_abstract: A U-Net based architecture for pixel-wise semantic segmentation of CT and MRI scans used in clinical decision support systems.

patents.patent_title: Anomaly detection using autoencoder neural networks
patents.patent_abstract: An unsupervised method for detecting outliers in time-series sensor data by training an autoencoder to reconstruct normal operating patterns.
